texts.Payments_Detail_BankFailed: The bank payment did not go through.
texts.Payments_Detail_Cancelled: The automatic payments were cancelled at the processor.
texts.Payments_Detail_ChargeFailed: An automatic payment failed. The processor tries again on its own schedule.
texts.Payments_Detail_Expired: The checkout was not finished in time.
texts.Payments_Detail_Reversed: The payment was reversed at PayPal, for example by a chargeback.
texts.Payments_Error_BadAmount: Enter an amount greater than zero.
texts.Payments_Error_BadCurrency: Use a three letter currency code, like USD.
texts.Payments_Error_BadUrl: The return addresses must start with https://.
texts.Payments_Error_NoDescription: Describe what the payment is for.
texts.Payments_Error_NoSubscription: This recurring gift has no automatic payments at the processor to update.
texts.Payments_Error_NotReady: {0} is not connected yet. Ask your BarnCRM admin to enter its keys on Payments Setup.
texts.Payments_Error_Processor: {0} could not start the checkout. Try again. If it happens again, ask your BarnCRM admin to check the Error Log.
texts.Payments_Event_Duplicate: Already received: this event was applied once.
texts.Payments_Event_NoMove: Not applied: a payment cannot move from {0} to {1}.
texts.Payments_Event_NoPayment: No BarnCRM payment matches this event, so it was left alone.
texts.Payments_Event_NotUsed: Payments does not use this kind of event.
texts.Payments_Event_NotVerified: PayPal did not confirm this event, so it was not applied. Check the Webhook ID on Payments Setup.
texts.Payments_Health_GuestAccessDetail: Stripe and PayPal send payment news to the Site, and its guest user needs the Payments Webhook Guest permission set to receive it. It grants the receiver only, and no record.
texts.Payments_Health_GuestAccessDone: Payments Webhook Guest given to the guest user of: {0}.
texts.Payments_Health_GuestAccessTitle: A Site Guest User Can't Receive Payment News
texts.Payments_Health_KeysMissingDetail: {0} is the chosen processor, but its keys are not all entered, so no checkout can start. Enter them on Payments Setup.
texts.Payments_Health_ModeMismatchDetail: Payments is in {0} mode, but the Stripe secret key is for the other mode. Enter the key that matches, or change the mode in Settings.
texts.Payments_Health_ModeMismatchTitle: Stripe Key Does Not Match the Mode
texts.Payments_Health_NoSiteDetail: Stripe and PayPal tell BarnCRM about payments through a Salesforce Site, and this org has no active Site. Create and activate one in Setup, under Sites. The admin guide page Payments shows the steps.
texts.Payments_Health_NotScheduledDetail: Received payment events are applied every 15 minutes by a scheduled job, which is not scheduled. Until it is, payments stay Pending.
texts.Payments_Health_NotScheduledDone: Payments processing is scheduled every 15 minutes, as you.
texts.Payments_Health_WaitingDetail: Some payment events were received over an hour ago and are not applied yet. Check that processing is scheduled and that the person who scheduled it is still active.
texts.Payments_Setup_Addresses: Give the processor the address for it. Each address is on the Site named beside it.
texts.Payments_Setup_Failed: Payments Setup could not load or save. Try again. If it happens again, check the Error Log.
texts.Payments_Setup_Intro: Connect your own Stripe or PayPal account. Payers pay on the processor's own page; BarnCRM keeps no card details. Keys are never shown again once saved: type a new value to change one, or leave a box empty to keep it.
texts.Payments_Setup_Mode: Mode: {0}. Checkouts use {1} unless a module asks for the other. Change these in Settings, under Payments.
texts.Payments_Setup_NoManage: Saving keys needs the Manage BarnCRM Settings permission. Ask your BarnCRM admin.
texts.Payments_Setup_NoSite: This org has no active Salesforce Site with an address, so there is nothing to give the processor yet. Create and activate a Site in Setup, under Sites; the admin guide page Payments shows the steps.
texts.Payments_Setup_NotScheduled: Processing is not scheduled, so nothing the processor reports reaches BarnCRM: payments stay Pending. Choose Schedule Processing to check for processor news every 15 minutes, run as you.
texts.Payments_Setup_Scheduled: Processing is scheduled: processor news is applied every 15 minutes, and checkouts abandoned for two days are cancelled.
